_note: Every badge in the game, exactly as it's written in the player JSON files (key/name/icon/tier/desc/rating -- tier and rating are per-player and only appear once a player actually qualifies; this is the master catalog itself). Sorted into 5 categories. A badge's 'attrs' field shows which player attributes determine whether they earn it and at what tier (Bronze 80+, Silver 85+, Gold 90+, HOF 95+, averaged across the listed attributes).

finishing.name: Slasher
finishing.desc: Explosive finisher who consistently converts at the rim in traffic.

finishing.name: Post Menace
finishing.desc: Bullies smaller defenders with back-to-the-basket scoring.

shooting.name: Sharpshooter
shooting.desc: Knocks down threes at an elite clip on catch-and-shoot and pull-up looks.

playmaking.name: Dimer
playmaking.desc: Elite table-setter who consistently creates good looks for teammates.

defense.name: Rim Protector
defense.desc: Alters shots and swats attempts around the basket.

defense.name: Lockdown Defender
defense.desc: Shuts down opposing ball-handlers on the perimeter.

defense.name: Pick-Pocket
defense.desc: Elite ball-hawk who consistently generates takeaways.

defense.name: Glass Cleaner
defense.desc: Dominates the boards on both ends of the floor.

physical.name: Iron Man
physical.desc: Rarely misses time -- a much lower baseline injury risk.

physical.name: High Motor
physical.desc: Non-stop energy that shows up in loose balls, closeouts, and effort plays.

physical.name: Brick Wall
physical.desc: Powerful frame that wins physical, bump-and-grind matchups.

tier_thresholds.Bronze: 80+ average across the badge's listed attrs
tier_thresholds.note: A player only carries a badge at all if they clear at least the Bronze threshold -- otherwise it's simply absent from their badges list, not shown at a 0/low tier.
